bounded_purpose: Develop only the pre-implementation design contract for a tactile, structural, playful GitHub-hosted TOML learning site built around examples, editable interfaces, simulated terminals, schemas, games, direct manipulation, immediate feedback, and a capstone; prohibit essay-style teaching copy and prohibit app/prototype implementation, package files, tests, workflows, screenshots, publishing, or deployment.

source.difference: The repository artifact replaces the reserved lint placeholder with the completed lint outcome; all Open Design-authored design content is otherwise preserved.

artifacts.identity_note: This record is identified by its repository path; a self-hash is omitted because embedding it would be self-referential.
